meta.name: World 1
meta.description: World 1 - the main world. The capital Aurelia sits above the southern beach with its airport, central station and harbor; the player starts there. Frosthold in the north-western snowfields is hard to reach: Frostpass Road is still under construction, the Frost Line freezes in extreme winters and its harbor can be blocked by snow. Difficulty rises from the southern heartlands (Lv 1) to the Blightlands and the Emberfall volcano (Lv 100).

props.note: Remote snow town. No finished road yet; the Frost Line and the harbor close in extreme winters.
Ice and heavy snow can block the harbor in winter.

props.text: Frostpass Road: construction in progress. Frosthold lies beyond the snowfields to the west.

props.note: Construction is still progressing; the road ends in the snowfields.
Tracks freeze and services stop during extreme winters.

properties.seasons: Extreme winters close the Frost Line and can block Frosthold Harbor.
